page.overview:
Who is The Emperor of All Chinese?

The Emperor is the emperor of all Chinese and one of the minor antagonist in Invincible, as he is the responsible for making the curse of Fung Cha's seventh grandchildrens (which results them having the ability to duplicate eachother).

The Emperor's backstory is largely unknown. As he became the emperor of China. Afterwards, the warlord helps everyone from the Emperor as he was actually evil well the warlord, Fung Cha, is the savior. One day, Fung Cha would carve a bloody path through the Emperor by killing all of his most elite guards, after his death, "he said The seventh generation after Cha's seventh grandchild would be burdened with a family too large to care for... and it would drive him mad,". Which results Fung Cha to kill him.

The Emperor died long after Fung Cha's seventh generation grandchildren was born. However, the curse actually resulted them to have the ability to duplicate themselves.
